name: Futures Platform Futures Table
description: A visual, collaborative scenario analysis tool integrated into the Futures Platform foresight workspace. It provides a structured matrix for mapping how key variables within trends, signals, or drivers might evolve across multiple plausible futures, enabling teams to synthesize insights and stress-test strategies.
reputation: Industry-standard component of a widely adopted commercial foresight platform used by strategy teams in corporations and governments.
notes: Commercial SaaS tool; strength lies in collaborative visualization and curated trend library rather than automated quantitative scoring. Outputs are interpretive and context-dependent.
